CachedAutodiffWorkspace Audit Report

Purpose

After implementing parameter optimization with finalize_parameters!, we need to ensure that CachedAutodiffWorkspace is created AFTER field rebuilding, not before.

Why This Matters

When finalize_parameters! is called, it rebuilds model fields from Vector{Float64} to Vector{Number} to accept Dual numbers. If a workspace is created before this rebuilding, it captures references to the OLD arrays and won't see parameter changes.

Key Pattern to Follow

# ✅ CORRECT ORDER:
sys = SystemModel(am, models)
psys = ParameterizedSystem(sys)
add_parameter!(psys, :Model, :field, instances)
finalize_parameters!(psys)                    # 1. Finalize FIRST
cache = CachedAutodiffWorkspace(psys.sys)      # 2. Cache AFTER

# ❌ WRONG ORDER (would cause stale references):
cache = CachedAutodiffWorkspace(sys)           # 1. Cache created
finalize_parameters!(psys)                    # 2. Rebuilds fields
# Cache now has stale references!

Conclusion

✅ ALL FILES ARE SAFE

  • No files create CachedAutodiffWorkspace before finalize_parameters!
  • All parameter-related examples correctly create cache after finalization
  • Documentation examples don't involve parameter systems
  • Test files either don't use cache or use it correctly

Recommendations

  1. For future code: Always create CachedAutodiffWorkspace AFTER finalize_parameters!
  2. Documentation: Current inline comments ("IMPORTANT: Create cache AFTER finalization!") are sufficient
  3. No action needed: All existing code is already correct
